title: OCI / Compute Instance Operations
description: Running OCI Compute fleet with per-instance health, CPU telemetry, maintenance, source visibility and alert rule examples. Unknown metrics remain explicit.

panels.title: Instance monitoring
panels.description: Fleet-wide collection state. Complete means source queries succeeded; it does not guarantee every OCI health signal exists for every instance.

targets.expr: max(((oci_compute_inventory_instance_monitoring_enabled + on (job, instance) oci_compute_inventory_instance_monitoring_collection_success) or oci_compute_inventory_instance_monitoring_enabled) and on (job, instance) topk(1, oci_compute_inventory_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds))

panels.title: Inventory snapshot age
panels.description: Instance rows are shown only for a successful inventory snapshot younger than three polling intervals.

targets.expr: max((time() - oci_compute_inventory_last_success_timestamp_seconds) and (oci_compute_inventory_last_success_timestamp_seconds > 0) and on (job, instance) topk(1, oci_compute_inventory_last_success_timestamp_seconds))

panels.title: Running instances in selected scope
panels.description: Every RUNNING instance matching the region, compartment, owner, environment and instance filters. Unknown telemetry remains in the roster.

panels.description: Scheduled or active events for running instances. OCI action is the operation OCI plans to perform. A dash means OCI omitted that time. Empty means no events only when collection is complete.

targets.expr: ((oci_compute_inventory_instance_maintenance_event{region=~"${region:regex}",compartment_path=~"${compartment:regex}",instance_id=~"${compute_instance:regex}",owner=~"${owner:regex}",environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) and on (job, instance) ((oci_compute_inventory_collection_success == 1) and on (job, instance) ((time() - oci_compute_inventory_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < on (job, instance) (3 * oci_compute_inventory_poll_interval_seconds)) and on (job, instance) topk(1, oci_compute_inventory_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds)))

panels.title: Failed OCI source queries
panels.description: A failed or timed-out query leaves a visibility gap for the signal and compartment shown. Region and compartment filters apply; these queries are shared across instances and ownership.

targets.expr: (oci_compute_inventory_instance_signal_query_success{region=~"${region:regex}",compartment_path=~"${compartment:regex}"} == 0) and on (job, instance) ((oci_compute_inventory_collection_success == 1) and on (job, instance) ((time() - oci_compute_inventory_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < on (job, instance) (3 * oci_compute_inventory_poll_interval_seconds)) and on (job, instance) topk(1, oci_compute_inventory_last_success_timestamp_seconds))

panels.title: CPU utilization history
panels.description: Sampled latest OCI one-minute maxima at each collector refresh. These are not continuous one-minute scrapes. Gaps remain gaps; verify source age before alerting.

targets.expr: ((oci_compute_inventory_instance_cpu_utilization_percent{region=~"${region:regex}",compartment_path=~"${compartment:regex}",instance_id=~"${compute_instance:regex}",owner=~"${owner:regex}",environment=~"${environment:regex}"}) and on (job, instance) ((oci_compute_inventory_collection_success == 1) and on (job, instance) ((time() - oci_compute_inventory_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < on (job, instance) (3 * oci_compute_inventory_poll_interval_seconds)) and on (job, instance) topk(1, oci_compute_inventory_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds)))

panels.title: Alert rule examples and operating guidance

options.content:
### Create alerts for your workloads

Filter the fleet, identify the instance OCID and owner, then create a Grafana alert rule against **Prometheus**. Use stable labels such as `instance_id`, `region`, and `compartment_path`; dashboard filters do not configure alert rules. Configure the contact point, routing labels, evaluation interval, pending period, and No Data / Error behavior.

For instance and source conditions below, append this freshness gate:
```promql
and on (job, instance) ((oci_compute_inventory_collection_success == 1) and on (job, instance) ((time() - oci_compute_inventory_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < on (job, instance) (3 * oci_compute_inventory_poll_interval_seconds)))
```

Create separate alerts for stale/failed inventory and collector unavailability so missing data is visible. Example pending periods are illustrative and should match your service objectives.

**Health issue** · example pending: 5m
```promql
oci_compute_inventory_instance_health > 0
```
Route by region, compartment and instance_id. Review the signal label.

**Missing CPU telemetry** · example pending: 10m
```promql
oci_compute_inventory_instance_agent_cpu_samples_present == 0
```
Use only for workloads where Compute Agent is expected.

**High CPU, source sample younger than 5 minutes** · example pending: 10m
```promql
(oci_compute_inventory_instance_cpu_utilization_percent > 90) and on (job, instance, instance_id) ((time() - oci_compute_inventory_instance_cpu_sample_timestamp_seconds) < 300)
```
90% is an example threshold. This is the latest one-minute maximum sampled each collection.

**Disruptive maintenance due within 24 hours** · example pending: 5m
```promql
(oci_compute_inventory_instance_maintenance_deadline_timestamp_seconds{maintenance_state="SCHEDULED",maintenance_action=~"REBOOT_MIGRATION|STOP|TERMINATE"} - time()) < 86400
```
Includes overdue deadlines; confirm the OCI action and owner.

**Source query failure** · example pending: 10m
```promql
oci_compute_inventory_instance_signal_query_success == 0
```
A permissions, throttling or timeout failure creates a visibility gap.

**Inventory collector unavailable** · example pending: 5m
```promql
absent(up{job="oci-compute-inventory"}) or (up{job="oci-compute-inventory"} == 0)
```
Set No Data and Error handling explicitly in Grafana.

**Stale or failed inventory** · example pending: 5m
```promql
(oci_compute_inventory_collection_success == 0) or ((time() - oci_compute_inventory_last_success_timestamp_seconds) > on (job, instance) (3 * oci_compute_inventory_poll_interval_seconds))
```

Queries, units and labels are available in each panel’s Inspect view. These examples do not create or enable any alerts.
